expected.quote: Full Year 2025 and Q3 Outlook Full-year revenue outlook is now in the range of $6.73 billion to $6.81 billion, representing growth of 3.4% to 4.6% reported, while maintaining growth of 2.5% to 3.5% core (1) . Non-GAAP EPS (3) is expected in the range of $1.35 to $1.37 per share.
